verdict.rationale: Polar exposes a broad, versioned public API: OpenAPI 3.1 specs, typed TypeScript and Python SDKs, the Checkout Session API, Customer State, Events Ingestion, per-call proration, and webhook endpoint CRUD. Its remote MCP server also lets agents look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits. However, nothing documents full UI parity, and several capabilities are described only as dashboard actions: creating and managing meters, configuring checkout links, and checking balance and payouts on the Finance page. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for meters, checkout links, payouts and balance, and independent hands-on confirmation that nothing is dashboard-only.
